title: The Manufactured-Threat Conspiracy
buried_truth: The forest is not the enemy. Corporations manufacture fear of the Preserve to sell protection from it.
loop: The Grail posts bounties and hazard notices.
Protection Coverage sells to communities like Hush, with prices climbing alongside sightings.
Soulspire supplies, looses, owns, or attracts dangerous soul-resonant assets.
Kazrak holds the Preserve concession and reclassified the workers who became the Bramble Union.
The capital ward depends on old forest-magic while the system fear-sells the forest.
future_arc: The failing Goldspire Relay is the on-ramp.
One-shot clues become future leads: pre-written hazard tag, Bramble testimony, Soulspire remains, rising-cost ledger.
Connections upward to the Continuance Protocol, Soulspire's soul-fuel economy, and the Endless of Truth stay GM-only.
guardrails: Do not hand this to players.
A reveal should cost rolls, investigation, and risk.
Keep the tone bureaucratic, funny, and humane.
